connectors.name: Seam 1 — Control-Number authority
connectors.trigger: Any context mints a traceable record
connectors.effect: A single immutable control number ({prefix}{YYMMDD}-{genocode}, 18 type codes) is issued and never edited/deleted

connectors.name: Seam 2 — Batch release reconciliation gate
connectors.effect: Batch moves to `hold` AND an incident ticket is auto-created (severity high)
connectors.contract: { controlNumber, chemistry, quantity, lineage, product, status } each {expected,actual} -> {batch, reconciliation:{passed,mismatches}, incident}

connectors.name: Seam 3 — LIMS webhook fan-out
connectors.effect: Creates a test-run + records cannabinoid/terpene results AND seeds a consumer-profile (PhytoFacts) from the same payload
connectors.contract: { facilityPrefix, genocode, sample.testId, cannabinoids, terpenes } -> { labResults, consumerProfile }

connectors.name: Seam 4 — Genocode / product master authority
connectors.effect: Genocode is the authority; product-master unifies the legacy batch.Product + SpecProduct models

connectors.name: Seam 6 — SSO + company-domain allowlist
connectors.effect: Email domain checked against the active CompanyDomainAllowlist before any user/session is created; role tiers applied
connectors.contract: isAllowedEmail(email) throws if domain not allowlisted; roles admin/quality/manager/operator + sales/facility-op/lab-tech

connectors.name: Seam 7 — Shared AI service (PII-stripped, provider fallback)
connectors.trigger: Any context requests AI assistance (SOP/CAPA, sales copy, consumer copy)
connectors.effect: callAiWithFallback strips customer PII + enforces spend cap (Anthropic -> Groq fallback)

connectors.name: Harvest FINISHED → control-number finish
connectors.effect: The harvest's control number is stamped finished (is_finished/finishedAt) — forward, no double-finish

connectors.name: Middleware — DATABASE_URL service guard
connectors.effect: Routes return 503 when their service wasn't built (DATABASE_URL unset) — graceful degradation

connectors.name: Middleware — shared HTTP helpers
connectors.effect: Stream JSON parse (parseBody), typed JSON write (sendJson), Bearer extraction (getAuthHeader), control-number inference helpers

connectors.name: Middleware — session validation
connectors.effect: Bearer session id resolved to the current user/session via identity service
